purpose: Final MK14/PPARG internal objective study: test whether a continuous BEDROC-aligned early-rank contrast with scaffold-stable signed Mobius interactions improves the strongest additive baseline and remains exactly quadratizable.

evidence_timing.experiment_class: final posthoc cross-target train-only objective development

objective.per_ligand_weight: w(r)=exp(-alpha*r), where r is the outer-train empirical receptor rank fraction and lower is better
objective.set_utility: For each seed and the median-seed consensus, mean active weight minus mean decoy weight; robust utility is the equal mean of consensus, mean-seed, and worst-seed contrasts.
objective.linear_coefficient: mean singleton utility over the three outer-train scaffold blocks
objective.pair_coefficient: signed stable pair Mobius residual U(ij)-U(i)-U(j)
objective.triplet_coefficient: signed stable third-order Mobius residual after subtracting all singleton and pair contributions
objective.formula: H(x)=sum_i h_i*x_i+sum_ij J_ij*x_i*x_j+sum_ijk K_ijk*x_i*x_j*x_k under fixed cardinality k
objective.quadratization: Each retained cubic term is reduced exactly with a Rosenberg product auxiliary and quadratic consistency penalty; no quadratization or hardware execution occurs in Stage40.

comparators.legacy_linear: Stage38 exact singleton robust-BEDROC selection; the strongest additive baseline carried forward unchanged
comparators.direct_classical: Stage38 beam-64 plus local-search selection on the true outer-train robust BEDROC landscape
comparators.early_linear: exact selection using only the Stage40 exponential early-rank singleton coefficients
comparators.model_classical: beam-64 plus deterministic one-swap local search on the full Stage40 signed objective

efficacy_gate.decision: Authorize an independently preregistered external-target replication only if mean objective/BEDROC Spearman is at least 0.7 on each target, each target has nonnegative mean scaffold-holdout deltas against both legacy linear and direct classical selection, and the model beats legacy linear in at least 18 of 32 cells.

difficulty_gate.decision: Record small-pool classical difficulty only if exact optimization strictly beats beam-64 plus local search in at least five of 32 cells. This gate is reported separately and is not required for external efficacy replication.

interpretation_boundary: Stage40 is the final post-hoc MK14/PPARG objective-development analysis. It reads only frozen training rows and cannot turn internal scaffold holdouts into independent validation. A positive efficacy gate would authorize one externally preregistered protein replication with no further weight changes. The separate difficulty gate only describes the present 16-receptor landscape. Neither gate authorizes quantum hardware or a quantum-advantage claim. A failed efficacy gate freezes further MK14/PPARG objective tuning and redirects the project to a quantum-application PoC or a new independently designed dataset.
